notes.title: Added Customizable Controls!
notes.content:
[b]Now you can rebind your controls! [/b]

Head over to "[b]Settings[/b]" menu and check it out! Use any keys that you are comfortable with. 
Also, you can rebind controller inputs. 🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38919702/f15c5e7c3443290d0f57f540bbda88b0d902ebc6.gif[/img]

[b]Also in this update:[/b]
- Reduced screen shake a bit
- Squashed some bugs 🐛
